message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.flares: The mark on its brow flares as it dies. It does not go out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.not_over: %s falls. You know it isn't over.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.learned.shot: %s has learned to take your shots.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.learned.blun: %s shrugs off your blows; it's learned them.
news.jaymoskingdoms.bane.climbed: %1$s, who hunts %2$s, is said to have climbed to rank %3$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.born: Something you buried today will not stay down. It has a name now: %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.arrives.kille: %1$s. The grave was kind to you. I was not. Again.
Back from the dark, %1$s? I keep the dark. I'll send you back.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.arrives.slain: You put me in the ground, %1$s. The ground gave me back. It always will.
Your blade knew my heart, %1$s. I have none left to find.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.arrives.again: %1$s. I have walked every night since we last met.
No rest for either of us, %1$s. I've seen to that.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.leaves.0: The night is long. I can wait.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.not_yours.0: Not by your hand. Tell %s I'll be waiting.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.not_yours.1: You are not the one I rose for. Go home, and tell %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.downed.0: Kneel, %1$s. You'll grow used to it.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.downed.1: Down, %1$s. Lie with my dead a while.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.note.0: %1$s. I wore your fall like a new mail coat. Rank %3$s now. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.note.1: They call me rank %3$s since you knelt, %1$s. The dead keep count. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.note.2: A token for you, %1$s: my blade, sharper by your blood. %2$s, rank %3$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.born: Word comes that a dead outlaw has a new name, and is spending yours. They call him %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.arrives.kill: %1$s! Every tavern on the road drinks to the day I killed you. Let's give them another.
Look who's walking again. %1$s, you're the best thing that ever happened to me.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.arrives.slai: You left me for dead, %1$s. Bad habit. I came back richer.
%1$s! Remember me? You should. You made me.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.arrives.agai: %1$s. Every man here follows me because of you. Let's remind them why.
My favourite name, %1$s. I wear it everywhere.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.leaves.0: Another day, friend. I've a reputation to keep.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.leaves.1: Lads, we're done. Let the hero catch their breath.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.not_yours.0: Not you. %s gets the honour, nobody else.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.not_yours.1: You'd steal %s's glory? I like you. Still no.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.downed.0: That's the one I'll tell, %1$s! On your knees!
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.downed.1: Stay down, %1$s. The lads need a story.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.note.0: Dear %1$s, your fall bought me a new axe and three more men. Rank %3$s. Your friend, %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.note.1: %1$s, the taverns sing it now: %2$s, rank %3$s, the one who beat you.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.note.2: %1$s: thank you. Nobody climbs like I climb on your name. Rank %3$s. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.born: Something below has taken the one you finished. It is sworn to you now, in the worst way. It calls itself %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.arrives.killed: Your soul smelled sweet the last time, %1$s. I want the rest.
%1$s. The fire remembers you. So do I.
You burned out my first life, %1$s. The pit gave me a hotter one.
%1$s! You sent me down. I came back with friends.
Every coal in the pit carries your name, %1$s.
%1$s. Our pact isn't done until one of us is ash.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.leaves.0: The pit calls. It always calls me back to you.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.leaves.1: Burn a while longer, little one.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.not_yours.0: Your soul isn't the one I was promised. %s's is.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.not_yours.1: Out of my way. I am sworn to %s alone.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.downed.0: Down in the cinders, %1$s, where you belong.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.note.0: %1$s, your fall fed the fire. I am rank %3$s now. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.note.1: A scorched page for %1$s: rank %3$s, and hungrier. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.note.2: %1$s. Each time you fall I grow. Rank %3$s. Count them. %2$s.
